The batch proves be-the-leader by telescoping cumulative losses, bounds successive FTL minimizers by midpoint strong convexity and Lipschitz continuity, and sums the resulting harmonic stability terms. This is a complete local proof and does not use the dissertation theorem sketch.

The batch combines the local FTL bound with a proved finite-horizon occupancy mixture decomposition and a hybrid-policy cost telescope; the geometric expert-use sum is bounded by grouping rounds into blocks of ceil(1/alpha).
